crossRefs.note: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.
Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not…
who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils; but they are not grieved for the affliction of…

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.
translations.bsb: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot all about him.
translations.kjv: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat
translations.asv: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
